rows.question: Under the UCB directions, can a UCB levy pre-payment charges on a floating rate loan to an individual for non-business purposes sanctioned in March 2026?
rows.answer: No: for a UCB, pre-payment charges are not permitted on all floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, with or without co-obligant(s), when the loan is sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026.  The older pre-payment-charge directions were withdrawn or repealed and are no longer in force on 2026-11-23.
